summary_md: **Tian Zhang (Brice) ([@BriceTian](https://x.com/BriceTian/status/2115821040848744633))** summarizes *Multiscale Policy Optimization for Long-Horizon LLM Agents* ([arXiv 2610.35013](https://arxiv.org/abs/2610.35013)): critic values vary across turns rather than tokens, and MPO's turn-level importance sampling with multiscale advantages beats GRPO, PPO and VAPO on all nine agent metrics at 4B and 30B (GAIA pass@3 56.24 vs. 50.34), with caveats about single runs and near-noise HLE gains.

referenced_urls.title: Multiscale Policy Optimization for Long-Horizon LLM Agents

relevance: Training insight for tool-use agents: credit by turn.
